mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app_chat_message ( id, tenant_id, session_id, application_id, role, content, content_format, model_invocation_log_id, token_count, citation_count, client_message_id, trace_id, created_at, created_by ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{tenantId}, #{sessionId}, #{applicationId}, #{role}, #{content}, #{contentFormat}, #{modelInvocationLogId}, #{tokenCount}, #{citationCount}, #{clientMessageId}, #{traceId}, #{createdAt}, #{createdBy} )

INSERT INTO kb_citation_record ( tenant_id, chat_message_id, knowledge_base_id, document_id, chunk_id, score, citation_text, created_at ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{chatMessageId}, #{knowledgeBaseId}, #{documentId}, #{chunkId}, #{score}, #{citationText}, #{createdAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, application_id, release_id, release_version, user_id, title, status, last_message_at, trace_id, created_at, created_by, updated_at, updated_by, deleted_at, version FROM app_chat_session WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND application_id = #{applicationId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY last_message_at DESC NULLS LAST, id DESC

SELECT id, tenant_id, session_id, application_id, role, content, content_format, model_invocation_log_id, token_count, citation_count, client_message_id, trace_id, created_at, created_by FROM app_chat_message WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC
